design: UU Farlands orbital array — repeating redstone cannon body
designer: cubicmetre (credited by Wemmbu; exact schematic revision unverified)

selection.mapping: local x = source z - 120; local y = source y - 55; local z = 65 - source x
selection.notes: Measured interior 100-block repeat. Preserve cannon body at source scale; exclude outlying parallel rail lane, distant walkway and repeated neighboring units to fit the existing 70-block rift.

license: No explicit redistribution license stated on the source listing; no new license asserted over upstream geometry.
changes: Import source block geometry and native visual model orientations without executing source data.
Do not import entities, block entities, inventories, signs or commands.
Decorative circuitry, portals and TNT remain inert; existing server artillery gameplay is unchanged.
Source water is displayed as light-blue glass and powder snow as a snow block.
The four original gold pressure plates bind a cast normal fishing rod, with equal orbital/drill probability.
Closed ender chest uses a non-ticking static shell with the native texture.
